content: {"reasoning": "The only denial history is CO-97 (service bundled into another paid service, not separately payable). Bundling denials are provider responsibility, so the balance cannot be shifted to the patient or the secondary payer, and there is no CO-16 info request to answer. An appeal was already filed and no new denial is on the table, so appeal/P2P are unavailable, and resubmitting risks a CO-18 duplicate denial. Since the service is deemed not separately payable and further touches add cost without progressing collection, the balance should be closed.", "action": "write_off"}
